name: Egress Engineer
tagline: Routes the bot's browser through your own Tailscale exit node.
description: Point the bot's web browsing at a machine you own on your Tailscale network and every request leaves through that device. Sites then see a home connection in your own country rather than a datacenter address, which helps where services turn away cloud traffic. Setup runs in order, from install to a verified path.
author: satsnode
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
